publication_surface.identifier: Official Journal references of harmonised standards supporting Directive 2014/35/EU
publication_surface.authenticity_basis: Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12 makes publication of a harmonised-standard reference in the Official Journal the condition for presumption of conformity with covered safety objectives.

dependencies.condition_statement: Presumption of conformity under Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12 depends on conformity with harmonised standards or parts whose references have been published in the Official Journal.

scope.statement: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2025/1457 schedules withdrawal of the OJ reference to EN 60335-2-60:2003 and its listed amendments/corrigenda from 18 January 2027.

source_refs.locator: Article 2 — Annex point (1) applies from 18 January 2027
Recital 16 — withdrawal of EN 60335-2-60:2003 reference is deferred to give manufacturers time to adapt

forbidden_inferences: Adoption of the 2025 withdrawal decision means the OJ reference disappeared immediately in July 2025.
A scheduled future withdrawal may be treated as current non-citation before 18 January 2027.
Withdrawal of the OJ reference means the underlying European standard ceases to exist.
Loss of presumption of conformity means compliance with Directive 2014/35/EU becomes impossible by other technical means.
The withdrawal is a textual mutation of Directive 2014/35/EU Article 12.
notes: Candidate-B scheduled-future-state regression. The binding decision exists from 2025 while its OJ-reference withdrawal takes effect only on 18 January 2027.
